name: GameSync Review Breakdown
author: gamesync

sections.description:
Score anything – a game, a movie, a restaurant, a product – across as many criteria as you want. The overall score is calculated for you and shown as stars, points or a percentage, with a breakdown per criterion and real schema.org Review markup for rich snippets.

Included in the free version

  • Works with posts, pages, Games and every custom post type.
  • Unlimited criteria with optional weights, and as many review templates as you need.
  • Stars, points or percentage.
  • Text below the criteria on the post page.
  • Review box block and the [gsrb_review_breakdown] shortcode, REST API field, right-to-left support.
  • A score badge ([gsrb_review_score] and a block) for archive cards and lists.
  • schema.org Review markup written as microdata on the visible review box.

Pro version

  • Template import / export.
  • Colors (background, text, bar / star, border) with presets and a live preview, also per template.
  • A custom heading per template, for example “Our Rating”.
  • The Good / The Bad lists above or below the criteria; empty lists are not shown.
  • Bars, compact, horizontal, gauge and radar layouts, score labels, an award badge, criterion descriptions, a buy button and a top-rated list.
  • Elementor widgets and Bricks elements.

The Pro version is included with a GameSync Game Data Importer Pro license and works with all GameSync themes and any other WordPress site. If a Pro license lapses the Pro features switch off; nothing you saved is deleted.

External services

This plugin can connect to Freemius (https://freemius.com), the licensing and checkout service used for the Pro version. The connection is optional and starts only if you click “Allow & Continue” on the opt-in screen shown after activation; until then nothing is sent. After you opt in, Freemius receives your site URL, WordPress and PHP versions, the plugin version, your name and email address (from your account) and the list of active plugins and themes, to provide licensing, updates and security notices. You can opt out at any time from the plugin’s Account page. See the Freemius terms of service (https://freemius.com/terms/) and privacy policy (https://freemius.com/privacy/).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/ or install it from the Plugins screen, then activate it.
  2. Go to GameSync Review Breakdown -> Templates and add a template with its criteria.
  3. Edit a post, pick the template in the GameSync Review Breakdown box and enter a score for each criterion.
  4. The review box appears automatically, or place it with the [gsrb_review_breakdown] shortcode.
sections.faq:
Does it work with any theme?

Yes. The review box is added after the content (or before it, or where you place the shortcode) and styles itself with a handful of CSS variables, so it works with block and classic themes.

What happens to my reviews if I stop using Pro?

Nothing is deleted. Pro features simply switch off, and everything you saved comes back when a Pro license is active again.
sections.changelog:
2.0.7

  • Changed: the free version now has no limit on the number of review templates, and no Pro notices inside the template and post editing screens.
  • Changed: the shortcodes are now [gsrb_review_breakdown] and [gsrb_review_score]. Posts that use the old [review_breakdown] and [review_score] keep working.
  • Changed: the confirmation shown before deleting a template that reviews still use is loaded as a script file instead of being printed into the page.
  • Fixed: the plugin’s website address in the plugin header.

2.0.6

  • Changed: the paid build is now called “Pro” (GameSync Review Breakdown Pro) instead of “Premium”, matching the plan name and the website.

2.0.5

  • Fixed: if the free plugin and the Premium build are installed at the same time, the second copy no longer loads (it would have caused a fatal error); the Freemius SDK deactivates the free copy when the Premium one is activated.

2.0.4

  • Fixed: the clean-up that runs when the plugin is deleted now uses WordPress’s own meta functions instead of a direct database query.
  • Changed: the editor blocks now declare block API version 3 (WordPress 7.0 iframe editor), the settings intro has a translators note, and the template-usage count query is prepared in one step.
  • Changed: contributors now match the plugin’s other directory listings.

2.0.3

  • Changed: preparation for the WordPress.org plugin directory (translation loader removed, form fields sanitized where they are read, readme documents the optional Freemius connection).

2.0.2

  • Changed: the plugin is connected to its Freemius product so the Pro version can be purchased and activated (1 site, 3 sites or unlimited sites).

2.0.1

  • Fixed: the Review Score Badge block now sits inside the content column on block themes.
  • Fixed: the score next to each bar no longer touches the end of the bar on some themes.

2.0.0

  • New: free and Pro versions. Pro adds colors, layouts, The Good / The Bad lists, template import / export and more.
  • New: a score badge shortcode and block.
  • Fixed: on right-to-left sites the review box was unstyled.
  • Fixed: deleting the plugin now also removes the color and audience-rating options.
  • Changed: colors, presets, the live preview and template import / export are Pro features.

1.10.2

  • Earlier releases: see the plugin’s change history.
